subject: BlueHarbor renewal — split payor & invoice schedule confirmation
messages:
From: Olivia Kim <olivia.kim@blueharbor.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@blueharbor.com
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + 25% capacity add — invoice routing and split payor

Hi Tessa / Jordan,

Thanks for the renewal summary — quick clarification from our side before we finalize PO and payment terms. We are renewing for the standard Redwood Dedicated plan and adding a 25% capacity uplift for Q4. Finance needs two things:

1) We need the invoice split so that 70% of the renewal charges go to BlueHarbor Analytics, Inc. (primary payor) — PO will be issued by our US entity.
2) The remaining 30% should be invoiced to BlueHarbor Europe Ltd (EUID: GB999888777) since that portion is funded by EU budgets and requires a separate billing contact, VAT evidence, and a different net term (Net 60 for the EU entity).

Can you confirm Redwood can emit two invoices per renewal period (one per legal entity) and accept two POs? Also: our procurement prefers a sample invoice layout showing the split and where VAT/EIN info will appear so they can sign off.

I attached the draft PO (BlueHarbor_PO_2028-09.pdf) for the primary payor. We'll upload the EU PO after we get the invoice sample.

Thanks — Olivia

--
Olivia Kim
Head of Procurement, BlueHarbor Analytics
olivia.kim@blueharbor.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Kim <olivia.kim@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 25% capacity add — invoice routing and split payor

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Great to hear about the capacity uplift. Short answers up front: yes, we can support two invoices and two POs; yes, we can provide a sample proforma showing the split and VAT/EIN placement.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus (cc'd) will validate the invoice format and confirm tax/VAT treatment for the EU entity.
- Jordan will generate a proforma quote that shows the line-item split (70/30) and a sample invoice PDF that your procurement can review.
- Once BlueHarbor confirms the EU PO number and provides VAT registration evidence for the Europe entity, we will finalize the DocuSign subscription amendment for the upsell + renewal.

Estimated timeline: sample PDF by EOD Wed (8/30), Marcus to confirm tax handling by Thu (8/31). If that works I'll schedule a 20-min call to walk procurement through the sample.

Attaching: RH-quote-2028Q4.pdf (proforma template) — placeholder until Jordan finalizes.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tessa_Mobile: +1 (650) 555-0147
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Kim <olivia.kim@blueharbor.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + 25% capacity add — invoice routing and split payor

Olivia / Tessa — I reviewed the scenario. We can issue two invoices with independent billing entities. A couple of compliance notes:

- For BlueHarbor Europe Ltd we'll need VAT registration evidence (PDF) and the exact billing address as registered with the tax authority.
- For the US payor we require a completed W-9 for the entity that will accept the invoice.
- Net terms: we can set Net 60 for the EU invoice and Net 30 (default) for the US invoice. If the US finance team prefers Net 45 / Net 60 we can discuss but that will go through our AR team and may require approval.

Please send the EU VAT doc and the W-9 to finance@redwood.com; reference deal BH-2028-REN-43 in the subject. Once we have both documents we will:
  1) Generate two final invoice templates with the split applied.
  2) Confirm PO number acceptance and link invoices to PO IDs in our billing system.

I'll patch in any tax-specific fields into Jordan's sample PDF once received.

— Marcus Lin
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Olivia Kim <olivia.kim@blueharbor.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Sep 2028 11:42:00 -07:00

Thanks Marcus — attaching the EU registration and the secondary PO (BlueHarbor_PO_EU_2028-09.pdf). Finance confirms:
- BlueHarbor Analytics, Inc. PO: PO-93744 (primary, US)
- BlueHarbor Europe Ltd PO: PO-EU-2201 (secondary, EU)

VAT registration (BlueHarbor Europe Ltd) attached. W-9 for the US entity is also attached (BlueHarbor_W9_2028.pdf).

Are you able to accept PO-EU-2201 as a separate PO on the renewal amendment and set Net 60 for that invoice line? Procurement would like the sample invoice PDF with the PO numbers shown before they issue the final acceptance.

Olivia

Attachments: BlueHarbor_PO_EU_2028-09.pdf; BlueHarbor_W9_2028.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized invoice plan + DocuSign link — BlueHarbor renewal

Olivia — all set, thanks for the speedy uploads. Summary and next steps: 

1) Billing plan agreed:
   - Invoice A (70%): BlueHarbor Analytics, Inc. — PO-93744 — Net 30 — W-9 on file.
   - Invoice B (30%): BlueHarbor Europe Ltd — PO-EU-2201 — Net 60 — VAT reg. on file (EU evidence).
2) Jordan attached the finalized sample invoices (see inline). The PDFs show the split, the line-level PO references, and tax IDs in the header as requested.
3) I created the subscription amendment and initiated DocuSign for signature — link below. Once signed we'll schedule the upgrade for the capacity add and lock in Q4 pricing.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/recipient?env=prod&doc=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/54321/BH-2028-REN-43

Final asks from BlueHarbor to close: please confirm who will be the billing contact for the EU invoice (name + email) and confirm whether AP will process two separate payments or a single payment with internal reconciliation. If AP prefers a single payment, we can issue invoices to both entities and include combined remittance instructions; otherwise we'll provide separate remittance details.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
